name: Hybrid Abominant

bonuses.name: Second Strike
bonuses.text: This Threat reduces the Multi-Attack penalty by 2DN, as though is had the Dual Wield Talent (Wrath & Glory, page 133)

bonuses.name: Extra Arm
bonuses.text: The Aberrant's extra arm confers the Second Strike bonus when each arm wields a different weapon, or a single weapon and a double handed weapon. Using all three arms allows the Abominant to ignore the Unwieldy weapon trait.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

abilities.name: Thunderous Charge
abilities.text: The Threat Seizes the Initiative without spending a point of Ruin and Charges. It gains an additional +1 Strength when it attacks.

abilities.name: Pulverise
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to add the game's Tier as ED to all attacks this Threat makes this Round.

determination: Unstoppable Bulk: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 8D6. This Threat can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds.
note: Block title 'Hybrid Abominants', heading 'Abominant'. No Unquestioning Loyalty reaction printed.
